charts.title: TOI-244 b: orbits around TOI-244
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-244's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-244 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Oddo et al. 2023 (2023AJ....165..134O), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname ODDO_ET_AL__2023): P 7.39726 d

charts.title: TOI-244 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-244 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (104, 105, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 118327550, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 16 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 23 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 7-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 16 min early; 7-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 8 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
